About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)
  9. Israel (Native Hebrew speakers)
  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.
